title: The Missed Line in the Song
youtube_title: The Missed Line in the Song | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Violeta is tangled up with a missed line you covered with a hum and almost hides it. Violeta tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
